open_points.subject: Flow activation action vs K-08 rule
open_points.text: K-08: "A read-only flow is activated by the kernel once proven; any other flow only by the owner." Primary action: "activate a flow | agent or owner asks; the kernel activates a proven read-only version at once; any other version only when the owner asks".
open_points.question: For a proven read-only flow version, is activation automatic immediately after proof, or only when someone calls the activate action?
options: Automatic on successful proof of a read-only version
Only via explicit activate action; read-only just needs no owner approval
open_points.default_guess: Only via explicit activate action, because activation is listed as a separate product action.

open_points.subject: Draft-write resend authority after not_applied
open_points.text: State 0 product statement: "...asks the owner before each effect of the classes K-08 stops for — a `draft-write` runs under the owner's activation of the flow instead"; M26: "...except a resend after `not_applied`, which, whatever its class, records the fresh approval it needed".
open_points.question: If a `draft-write` attempt is resolved `not_applied` and retried, must that retry obtain a per-attempt owner approval, or still run only under flow activation authority?
options: Retry requires fresh owner approval even for `draft-write`
`draft-write` never needs per-attempt approval; retry still uses activation authority
open_points.default_guess: Retry requires fresh owner approval for any class, following "whatever its class".

open_points.subject: Re-activating an already active flow version
open_points.text: Primary action output is only "active flow version"; M18 says "A flow's active version is the one recorded last ... a new activation replaces the previous one at once" but does not say what happens when the requested version is already active.
open_points.question: When activate is called for the version that is already active, does the kernel create a new FlowActivation record or return the existing active state without change?
options: Idempotent return, no new activation record
Always append a new activation record (new "last" activation)
open_points.default_guess: Idempotent return with no new record.

open_points.subject: ManifestOperation/base_url when no instance is selected
open_points.text: M10 defines `base_url` as "the manifest's base URL of the one instance the installation selects for the service"; M28 says "a service with none selected is not invocable" and only states absence behavior for `required_headers` and `instance_class`, not `base_url`.
open_points.question: If no instance is selected for a service, does ManifestOperation exist without `base_url`, or is reading/proposing/accepting bindings for that service refused at model-read time?
options: ManifestOperation can still be read for capability typing; invocation later refuses
ManifestOperation read/ref is refused when no instance is selected
open_points.default_guess: Allow reading/proposal from manifest capability, but invocation refuses until an instance is selected.
